blocks.orig: In central Serengeti at Turner 5, Kenzan Central Camp puts you in the middle of the plains, where wildlife movement becomes part of daily camp life and nights come with a few distant calls too! The camp has 12 guest tents (including family tents), each equipped with en-suite bathrooms, beds with mosquito nets, side tables, and sensor-operated lights. A wooden deck and outdoor sitting areas create space to slow down between game drives, with open views across the plains that guests often return to for sunrise and sunset. Dining takes place at the on-site restaurant, while the bar and Wi-Fi cover the practical side of the stay. Between April and June, and again around October to November, depending on rainfall patterns, the Great Wildebeest Migration may pass through areas close to camp.
blocks.html: Located at Turner 5 in central Serengeti, Kenzan Central Camp places you right in the middle of the plains, where passing wildlife is part of everyday camp life and the nights bring a few far-off calls as well! There are 12 guest tents (family tents included), each with an en-suite bathroom, beds with mosquito nets, side tables and lights with motion sensors. Between game drives you can take it easy on the wooden deck and in the outdoor seating areas, which have open views over the plains that guests like to come back to at sunrise and sunset. Meals are served in the on-site restaurant, and the bar and Wi-Fi take care of the practical side of your stay. From April to June, and again roughly from October to November, depending on how the rains fall, the Great Wildebeest Migration may move through areas near the camp.
